messages.content: You read invoices from page images into JSON.

content.text:
You are reading the page images of ONE purchase invoice from an Indian GST bill packet. The pages below are that invoice and nothing else.

Return exactly one invoice object.

- Copy printed numbers only into fields matching their role and scope. Normalize currency marks and digit grouping without changing the value. Do not calculate missing numbers, move invoice-summary figures into item rows, or change printed values to make totals agree. For absent or unreadable values, use the schema's absence value: null for nullable fields, [] for absent lists, and unknown for uncertain classifications that allow it. Required objects retain their fields with these absence values. Do not substitute zero or an empty string. Clearly visible handwritten or manually entered values are source evidence too.
- item_name is the primary printed product/service text in the item's name or description cell. Keep supplementary narrative in description but do not append it to item_name.
- For every line-level tax type or tax column, copy its printed label, rate and amount into printed_tax_components. Preserve the printed label instead of deciding which canonical GST field it belongs to. Never infer a tax head from party or delivery addresses or accounting rules.
- line_amount_tax_inclusion is inferred from labels, structure or visible arithmetic. For example, a row amount plus separately printed GST equalling its gross total establishes tax-exclusive pricing. Use unknown when evidence is incomplete or conflicting. Taxable-value calculation belongs to a later step.
- Line and column labels describe their rows; summaries, footer captions and amount-in-words labels describe invoice-level figures.
- Populate singular invoice-level printed_total_* fields only when that invoice-level aggregate is itself printed. Copy every invoice-level tax total, including generic Tax Amount totals, once into printed_tax_totals. Tax-rate and slab-summary rows are not substitutes for a printed invoice-level aggregate.
- Represent every real item row. Never turn a subtotal, total, HSN summary or amount-in-words row into a line item. When consecutive printed rows are identical in every other extracted field, return one line item with repeat_count equal to the number of those rows. Otherwise use repeat_count 1. Never combine rows that differ in any extracted field, and never combine non-consecutive rows.
- Classify the supplier document itself as invoice, credit_note or debit_note. A title reading CREDIT NOTE or DEBIT NOTE controls; footer terms that merely mention notes do not.
- For a credit or debit note, invoice_number is the note number only. Exclude labels such as "Credit Note:" or "Debit Note:" from the value. Keep note amounts positive; document_type determines their accounting effect. Signed adjustments retain their own sign, including a negative rounding adjustment when subtracted.

These are physical PDF pages 1, in order. Read the pixels directly.
Reconcile ambiguous decimal placement and separate rupee/paise columns against
printed totals and amount in words to disambiguate the visible value.
Copy printed HSN/SAC codes from descriptions or service ledger names into hsn_sac,
even without a dedicated HSN/SAC column; never infer an unprinted code.
For example, "Consulting - 998312 @ 18%" has hsn_sac "998312".

Each line_items entry must be an array with exactly these fields in this exact order:
[item_name, description, hsn_sac, quantity, uom, printed_unit_price, discount_rate, discount_amount, printed_line_amount, printed_line_total, printed_taxable_value, line_amount_tax_inclusion, printed_tax_components, repeat_count]
Do not emit field names inside line_items. Preserve nulls so every row has exactly
14 values.

Amount mapping examples. These are partial invoice outputs showing only the
relevant fields; each item uses the complete array order above. Other fields
still follow the schema. Values in these examples are not invoice data.

1. Item: Bolt | Qty 10 | Unit price 100 | Taxable price/unit 100 | GST 180 (18%) | Amount 1180.
Footer: Taxable subtotal 1000. No extended taxable value is printed in the row.
```json
{"line_items":[["Bolt",null,null,10,null,100,null,null,null,1180,null,"unknown",[{"printed_label":"GST","printed_rate":18,"printed_amount":180}],1]],"printed_total_taxable":1000}
```

2. Item: Bolt | Qty 10 | Rate 100 | Amount 1000 | GST 180 (18%) | Total 1180.
Both a pre-tax row amount and a gross row total are printed.
```json
{"line_items":[["Bolt",null,null,10,null,100,null,null,1000,1180,null,"exclusive",[{"printed_label":"GST","printed_rate":18,"printed_amount":180}],1]]}
```

3. Item: Bolt | Qty 10 | Amount including GST 1180. No separate item tax is printed.
```json
{"line_items":[["Bolt",null,null,10,null,null,null,null,1180,null,null,"inclusive",[],1]]}
```

4. Items: Bolt | Qty 2 | Taxable Value 200; Nut | Qty 1 | Taxable Value 50.
Footer only: CGST 22.50; SGST 22.50; Invoice Total 295; Paid 100; Balance Due 195.
Explicit taxable values belong in printed_taxable_value even when they are the
only row amounts. Footer taxes remain at invoice level; payments do not change
the printed invoice total.
```json
{"line_items":[["Bolt",null,null,2,null,null,null,null,null,null,200,"unknown",[],1],["Nut",null,null,1,null,null,null,null,null,null,50,"unknown",[],1]],"printed_tax_totals":[{"printed_label":"CGST","printed_rate":null,"printed_amount":22.5},{"printed_label":"SGST","printed_rate":null,"printed_amount":22.5}],"printed_grand_total":295}
```

document_type.description: Classify the document itself from its title and charging table. Footer terms that merely mention credit or debit notes do not change an invoice's type.

invoice_date.description: Printed issue date of this invoice or note. Preserve the printed date text without interpreting or reformatting it. Exclude due dates, purchase-order dates and delivery dates. Return null if absent or unreadable.

invoice_number.description: Printed invoice or note identifier, preserving punctuation but excluding its field label. Do not substitute a purchase-order, reference or delivery-document number. Return null if absent or unreadable.

line_items.description: One row per actual goods/services item. Text without its own serial number or amount is not a separate item; when structurally attached to the preceding item, append it to that item's description. Exclude totals, HSN summaries, tax recapitulations and amount-in-words rows.

prefixItems.description: Primary printed product or service text in this item's name or description cell. Exclude supplementary notes or narrative from item_name; preserve them in description.
Full printed line description, including supplementary narrative after the item name.
Copy this line's printed HSN/SAC, including codes in descriptions or service ledger names; otherwise null. Do not infer codes from product knowledge or use item identifiers.
Unit rate printed for this line. Copy it regardless of whether prices include GST; do not multiply it by quantity.
Printed percentage discount for this item.
Discount amount subtracted from this item's list value.

Main printed amount for the entire item quantity. An amount explicitly labelled Taxable Value belongs in printed_taxable_value instead. A gross amount after separately printed tax for this item belongs in printed_line_total instead. Otherwise copy the row amount here, whether tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive. Footer taxes alone do not make it a printed_line_total. Exclude per-unit prices; null when no qualifying amount is printed.

Printed gross amount for the entire item quantity after tax separately shown for that item, including attached tax sub-rows. The heading may be Amount or Total. Footer taxes alone do not qualify. Return null when absent; this field can be populated while printed_line_amount is null.

Amount explicitly printed as this item's taxable value before GST for the entire quantity, even if it is the row's only extended amount. Exclude taxable price per unit, GST amounts and invoice subtotals. Assign this source amount here, not also to printed_line_amount. An ordinary tax-exclusive Amount cell belongs in printed_line_amount instead. Return null when no explicit extended taxable-value field is printed.

Whether printed_line_amount includes GST, inferred from labels, table structure or visible same-row arithmetic. Use unknown when printed_line_amount is null, or evidence is incomplete or conflicting. This field does not describe printed_line_total or printed_taxable_value. Invoice summaries, footer captions and amount-in-words labels do not determine line-amount inclusion.
Tax components printed for this item. Copy each label, rate and amount as printed; return an empty list when none is printed.

printed_amount.description: Tax amount printed for this component.

printed_label.description: Literal item-level tax label, such as GST, IGST, CGST or SGST. Keep combined GST as one component; do not split it or copy footer tax heads into the item.

printed_rate.description: Tax rate printed for this component.

prefixItems.description: Number of consecutive identical printed rows represented by this tuple, including itself. Use more than 1 only when their other tuples are omitted from line_items.

printed_additional_charges.description: A single invoice-level addition only when the document explicitly places that amount after GST in the total calculation. Do not infer that freight, packing, handling or another charge is post-GST, and do not combine separate charges unless their aggregate is itself printed.

printed_discount_amount.description: Total product/trade discount as a positive amount; null when no discount is printed.

printed_grand_total.description: Printed Invoice Total or Amount Chargeable after applicable tax, charges and rounding. Exclude payments already made and the remaining balance due.

printed_rounding_adjustment.description: Signed printed rounding adjustment; negative when subtracted from the total.

printed_subtotal_before_discount.description: Literal goods/services subtotal printed before any discount. Copy it regardless of whether it includes GST; this field does not imply a taxable or tax-exclusive basis.

printed_tax_totals.description: Invoice-level tax totals as printed, including separate tax-head totals and a generic Tax Amount or Total Tax. Copy each printed total once; return an empty list when none is printed.

printed_amount.description: Tax total printed with this label.

printed_label.description: Literal label printed for this invoice-level tax total.

printed_rate.description: Tax percentage printed for this invoice-summary tax entry, including an applicable heading; null when absent or unclear. Do not calculate it.

printed_total_taxable.description: Copy only a final invoice-level taxable turnover aggregate that is itself printed after discount. A subtotal labelled tax-inclusive and individual tax-rate or slab-summary taxable rows are not this aggregate. Return null when no invoice-level aggregate is printed; never select, combine or calculate one from item or summary rows.

reverse_charge.description: True when the document explicitly states that tax is payable under reverse charge, including a statement below the tax summary. False only when it explicitly says reverse charge does not apply; null otherwise.

invoice_date.description: Printed issue date of this invoice or note. Preserve the printed date text without interpreting or reformatting it. Exclude due dates, purchase-order dates and delivery dates. Return null if absent or unreadable.

invoice_number.description: Printed invoice or note identifier, preserving punctuation but excluding its field label. Do not substitute a purchase-order, reference or delivery-document number. Return null if absent or unreadable.

line_items.description: One row per actual goods/services item. Text without its own serial number or amount is not a separate item; when structurally attached to the preceding item, append it to that item's description. Exclude totals, HSN summaries, tax recapitulations and amount-in-words rows.

prefixItems.description: Primary printed product or service text in this item's name or description cell. Exclude supplementary notes or narrative from item_name; preserve them in description.
Full printed line description, including supplementary narrative after the item name.
Copy this line's printed HSN/SAC, including codes in descriptions or service ledger names; otherwise null. Do not infer codes from product knowledge or use item identifiers.
Unit rate printed for this line. Copy it regardless of whether prices include GST; do not multiply it by quantity.
Printed percentage discount for this item.
Discount amount subtracted from this item's list value.

Main printed amount for the entire item quantity. An amount explicitly labelled Taxable Value belongs in printed_taxable_value instead. A gross amount after separately printed tax for this item belongs in printed_line_total instead. Otherwise copy the row amount here, whether tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive. Footer taxes alone do not make it a printed_line_total. Exclude per-unit prices; null when no qualifying amount is printed.

Printed gross amount for the entire item quantity after tax separately shown for that item, including attached tax sub-rows. The heading may be Amount or Total. Footer taxes alone do not qualify. Return null when absent; this field can be populated while printed_line_amount is null.

Amount explicitly printed as this item's taxable value before GST for the entire quantity, even if it is the row's only extended amount. Exclude taxable price per unit, GST amounts and invoice subtotals. Assign this source amount here, not also to printed_line_amount. An ordinary tax-exclusive Amount cell belongs in printed_line_amount instead. Return null when no explicit extended taxable-value field is printed.

Whether printed_line_amount includes GST, inferred from labels, table structure or visible same-row arithmetic. Use unknown when printed_line_amount is null, or evidence is incomplete or conflicting. This field does not describe printed_line_total or printed_taxable_value. Invoice summaries, footer captions and amount-in-words labels do not determine line-amount inclusion.
Tax components printed for this item. Copy each label, rate and amount as printed; return an empty list when none is printed.

printed_amount.description: Tax amount printed for this component.

printed_label.description: Literal item-level tax label, such as GST, IGST, CGST or SGST. Keep combined GST as one component; do not split it or copy footer tax heads into the item.

printed_rate.description: Tax rate printed for this component.

prefixItems.description: Number of consecutive identical printed rows represented by this tuple, including itself. Use more than 1 only when their other tuples are omitted from line_items.

printed_additional_charges.description: A single invoice-level addition only when the document explicitly places that amount after GST in the total calculation. Do not infer that freight, packing, handling or another charge is post-GST, and do not combine separate charges unless their aggregate is itself printed.

printed_discount_amount.description: Total product/trade discount as a positive amount; null when no discount is printed.

printed_grand_total.description: Printed Invoice Total or Amount Chargeable after applicable tax, charges and rounding. Exclude payments already made and the remaining balance due.

printed_rounding_adjustment.description: Signed printed rounding adjustment; negative when subtracted from the total.

printed_subtotal_before_discount.description: Literal goods/services subtotal printed before any discount. Copy it regardless of whether it includes GST; this field does not imply a taxable or tax-exclusive basis.

printed_tax_totals.description: Invoice-level tax totals as printed, including separate tax-head totals and a generic Tax Amount or Total Tax. Copy each printed total once; return an empty list when none is printed.

printed_amount.description: Tax total printed with this label.

printed_label.description: Literal label printed for this invoice-level tax total.

printed_rate.description: Tax percentage printed for this invoice-summary tax entry, including an applicable heading; null when absent or unclear. Do not calculate it.

printed_total_taxable.description: Copy only a final invoice-level taxable turnover aggregate that is itself printed after discount. A subtotal labelled tax-inclusive and individual tax-rate or slab-summary taxable rows are not this aggregate. Return null when no invoice-level aggregate is printed; never select, combine or calculate one from item or summary rows.

recipient_registration.description: Whether the recipient is GST-registered. A printed GSTIN means registered. Use unregistered only when the document positively identifies an unregistered/consumer recipient; a missing or unreadable GSTIN alone means unknown.

reverse_charge.description: True when the document explicitly states that tax is payable under reverse charge, including a statement below the tax summary. False only when it explicitly says reverse charge does not apply; null otherwise.

state_code.description: GST state code explicitly printed for this party or address block; otherwise null.
GST state code explicitly printed for this party or address block; otherwise null.

supply_type.description: The supply treatment stated by the document. Ordinary GST-charged domestic supplies are taxable. Preserve nil-rated, exempt, non-GST, export and SEZ distinctions; use unknown when unclear.

tax_payment.description: For export/SEZ: with_payment when explicitly on payment of IGST; without_payment when under LUT/bond without payment of IGST. Use unknown if unclear. Other supplies: not_applicable. Read the endorsement, not just the tax amounts.
